hooks.commandWindows: $s = $null; foreach ($r in $env:ProgramFiles, ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}, $(if ($env:LOCALAPPDATA) { "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs" } elseif ($env:USERPROFILE) { "$env:USERPROFILE\AppData\Local\Programs" })) { if ($r -and -not $s) { $p = "$r\Git\bin\sh.exe"; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { $s = $p } } }; if (-not $s) { foreach ($c in (Get-Command sh -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $q = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $c.Source); if ($q -and -not $s -and ((Test-Path -LiteralPath "$q\usr\bin\cygpath.exe") -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$q\bin\cygpath.exe"))) { $s = $c.Source } } }; if (-not $s) { $g = Get-Command git -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($g) { $p = (Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $g.Source)) + '\bin\sh.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { $s = $p } } }; if (-not $s) { $o = findstr /n /r "^" 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and -not ($o -notmatch "^[0-9]+:") -and -not ($o -match '(\*\*\* (Add File|Update File|Delete File|Move to): |"file_path"\s*:\s*")([^"\\]|\\[\\/]|\\u[0-9a-f]{4})*\.(bbj|src|bbx)(\\[nr]|")')) { exit 0 }; cmd /c "echo bbj-check: Git for Windows sh.exe not found, so BBj files are not compile-checked. 1>&2 & echo Looked in Program Files Git bin, Program Files x86 Git bin, LOCALAPPDATA Programs Git bin, a Git sh on PATH, bin next to git on PATH. 1>&2 & echo Install Git for Windows or put its bin folder on PATH. 1>&2"; exit 2 }; & $s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/bbj-check.sh"; if ($null -eq $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 1 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE
